comment_regular: [Verified] ActorProcessManager_LoadTempEffects reads a UInt16 count and one-byte type tags. Type 0 constructs BSTempEffectDecal; type 1 constructs BSTempEffectGeometryDecal; type 2 constructs BSTempEffectParticle; types 5/6 construct MagicModelHitEffect/MagicShaderHitEffect. Successful virtual LoadGame results are re-registered by GetTypeID. The base BSTempEffect type returns 3 but is not saveable; type 4 has no handler in this switch and its producer/restore role remains Unknown.
